caseNameFull: In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Daniel ROZENSTRAUCH.

opinions.text:
In the Matter of DISCIPLINE OF Daniel ROZENSTRAUCH.

Daniel Rozenstrauch, of Chicago, Illinois, is suspended from the practice of law in this Court and a rule will issue, returnable within 40 days, requiring him to show cause why he should not be disbarred from the practice of law in this Court.
